evidence: In our experiments of TiN-ALD on SiO2/Si substrates, two reactant gases, tetrakis (dimethylamido)-titanium (TDMAT) and NH3 were alternately supplied into the reaction chamber at the deposition temperature of 180 °C. Thus, one deposition cycle is composed of a sequential supply of TDMAT vapor pulse, purge gas pulse, NH3 gas pulse and purge gas pulse.
